followups.description: osquery reports some unconnected UDP rows with IPv6 family but an IPv4 unspecified remote-address representation. normalize checks family before destination absence and rejects these as invalid_rows.
followups.impact: Usable connections remain visible, but normal reads return partial with invalid_rows instead of classifying this known missing destination as destination_unavailable.
followups.next: Add a synthetic regression for the observed shape, normalize the unspecified destination before family validation as appropriate, then repeat real CLI/MCP acceptance. Do not infer an actual UDP destination.
followups.resolution: Normalized with regression coverage; actual Mac CLI and local MCP both completed without invalid_rows on 2026-10-30.

followups.description: Windows/Linux native acceptance, administrator-vs-standard-user visibility, routing/VPN/disconnect and short-lived/unconnected UDP coverage remain unverified.
Normal windows finished in about 10.26s and actual cancellation was checked. A deliberately stalled real osquery read and forced full-operation timeout were not exercised in this trial.

initial_unsuccessful_attempt.note: The first CLI attempt while the source was changing returned an internal NameError. Direct reads and the fixed copy did not reproduce it.

likely_cause.explanation: A review fix was applied in two edits: connections.py used order() from 07:28:51 JST and defined it at 07:29:23 JST. A process that imported the module in between fails when it sorts the result, after the observation window.
likely_cause.reproduced_2026_10_30: A scratch copy with order() removed returned status error with 'Unexpected internal error (NameError)' for synthetic rows.
likely_cause.prevention: Interdependent edits are applied in one write while trials may run from the same working tree.

browser_harness_iteration.initial_failure: The verification function referenced a Node-side expected value from browser-side evaluation without passing it as an argument.
browser_harness_iteration.resolution: Passed the numeric count explicitly; repeated complete browser assertions passed. No application source change.

full_test_note: This was an actual-host/browser acceptance run, not another full Python/npm test run. The prior 2026-10-29 automated verification record covers its stated earlier source only.

evidence.retention: Temporary local files may be removed by the OS; only this identifier-free acceptance record is added to the repository.
